changelog:
Initial release of the Local-Only 3D Printer Maintenance Assistant.
Includes offline troubleshooting, maintenance workflows, vision analysis, G-code generation, profile management, and log export.
Version 1.0.0.


Local-only 3D printer maintenance assistant released.

- Diagnose common print failures and receive maintenance guidance via text  
- Premium features: analyze printer issues using images and generate calibration G-code  
- Save/load tuning profiles and export maintenance logs as CSV  
- Runs 100% offline using local LLMs (Llama3, LLaVA) through OpenClaw  
- No hardware or printer control—informational and file-based only
summary: Offline assistant for FDM 3D printer troubleshooting, maintenance guidance, image analysis, calibration G-code, profile management, and log export.
